source.dataset: Google Books Ngram Viewer, English Fiction 1-grams, 2020 release (v3, 20200217)
source.years: 1990-2019 edition years, volume-weighted (no book or author dimension)
source.denominator: 97330709341 untagged 1-grams containing a letter or digit
source.lemmatizer: writemorebetter en_tokenizer.bin tagger lookup, readings restricted to the Penn tags of the Ngram universal tag; capitalized forms excluded when they have a proper-noun reading or outnumber their lowercase form (nouns: 0.1 of it); ambiguous forms assigned to their most frequent lemma; ADP, CONJ and PRT uses added to lemmas with content uses (a preposition use keeps its content readings in a document); British spellings counted under the American key (overused_words.rs SPELLING_VARIANTS)
source.content: 14382 content lemmas (NOUN, VERB, ADJ, ADV; the report's function words, particles and fillers excluded) at or above 1 per million, counted from forms with at least 1000 occurrences; rates per million words to 3 significant digits
